title: [Decision] The changesets-v3 epic #9465 is implemented but still fenced — releasing the territory in prose does NOT unblock the three cards behind it, only closing #9465 does
body:
Filed by the triage seat (#6015), R+75. ⛔ Unassigned.

## Why this card exists at all — it is the carrier that was missing

On 2026-08-31T15:14Z the triage seat posted a full status review on **#9465** ending in *「建议(维护者的一句话即可)」*. That recommendation is **the only record of a maintainer decision request**, and it lives in a comment on a card that is `pm:on-hold` + `pm:epic` ⇒ **invisible to the decision-inbox query, to the sweep, and to every ageing alarm.** The inbox measured minutes ago (14 cards) does not contain it.

⚠️ This is the **third** instance of this exact failure mode from this seat lineage in one day — R+68 put a capacity escalation only in prose, R+69 caught it and wrote the rule, then R+69's own successor did it again here. R+69's note applies verbatim: *「这个失效模式对诊断出它的座位同样有效」*. ⇒ Filed now as the card the protocol requires. ⛔ The substance below is the predecessor's measurement, credited, not re-derived — except item 3, which corrects it.

## 1 · The migration is DONE (measured on `origin/main`, by the predecessor)

```
package.json:164        "@changesets/cli": "^3.0.0"
.changeset/config.json  "$schema": ".../@changesets/config@4.0.0/schema.json"
___experimentalUnsafeOptions_WILL_CHANGE_IN_PATCH  →  0 hits (removed)
```

Sub-issues **4 of 5 closed**: #9497 (rehearsal) · #9498 (the atomic migration PR itself) · #9499 (`changesets/action`) · #9518 (p0). Only **#9500** (verify inside a real RC window) remains.

## 2 · #9500 waits for the next MAJOR, not the next release

Measured from tags (7610, complete) with a working control:

| line | RC tags | GA |
|:--|--:|:--|
| `17.0.0` | **483** (rc.0→rc.6, 07-28→08-10) | 2026-08-14 |
| `17.1.0` | **0** | 2026-08-20 |
| `17.2.0` | **0** | 2026-08-23 |

⇒ minors ship straight to GA; **only a major enters pre-mode**. The epic was filed 2026-08-18, *after* the only pre window closed. ⇒ #9500's wait is measured in **months (v18)**, not "the next release".

## 3 · ⭐ The correction — the predecessor's recommendation does not actually work

Its proposal was *「现在释放文件围栏,#9500 保留它自己的 `pm:on-hold`」* — release the fence, keep #9465 open.

⛔ **That does not unblock the three cards.** #9709, #9828 and #10667 each carry `Blocked-by: #9465`, and the unlock predicate the sweep evaluates is **"the target CLOSED"** — not "the target's territory was released in a comment". An open `pm:on-hold` card is, by definition, a state a card sits in *while open*. ⇒ Under that proposal all three stay blocked **forever**, with the fence nominally released and nothing to show for it.

This is the half-state patrol's **H26** shape, and #9465 is its highest-fanout instance on the board: three cards waiting on a target that no mechanism can close. It is also **H9** — the hold carries no machine-fireable `Restart-when:` in either channel. ⇒ Two independent rows, same card, and neither alone says the block is unreleasable.

## 4 · What is stuck behind it

- **#9709** — `release.yml` and `ci.yml` share one console-dist cache key with no `check:console-injection` step; `release.yml` uses a **save-on-failure** cache action and the console job is **path-filtered**, so "ci.yml catches it first" does not hold. ⭐ **A cache-poisoning surface, one step to fix.**
- **#9828** — `cut-rc.yml`'s operator warning still tells the release curator that `changeset pre exit` re-arms a gate whose keying already changed. It renders **in the live release run annotations**, at the moment the curator decides.
- **#10667** — per the 08-26 patrol; ⚠️ **not individually re-verified** as still pointing here.

⇒ An epic whose implementation finished is holding a security-shaped fix behind a fence with **no remaining work behind it**.

## Options

| | Option | Consequence |
|:--|:--|:--|
| **A** | Release the territory, keep #9465 open for #9500 | ⛔ **Does not unblock anything** — see §3. Fence released in prose, three cards still `pm:blocked` on an open target. |
| **B** | Status quo — hold everything until v18 | Three cards, one a poisoning surface, parked for months behind finished work. |
| **C** ⭐ | **Close #9465 `completed`; #9500 stands alone carrying its own `Restart-when: .changeset/pre.json exists`** | The epic's implementation *is* complete (4/5, and the 5th is verification, not editing). Closing it **fires the unlock predicate**, returning all three cards to the queue mechanically. The fence dissolves with the epic. #9500 keeps waiting for v18 as its own card, which is what it actually is. |

**Recommendation: C.** It is the only option whose stated effect matches what the machinery does. ⛔ Recorded as a recommendation, not an action — closing an epic parent and dissolving a declared territory belongs to the holder or the maintainer, ⛔ never to triage.

⚠️ **One thing C must not lose**: #9500's own `Restart-when:` must be verified present and machine-fireable *before* #9465 closes; otherwise C trades a 3-card block for a lost verification.

## 5 · The epic body is stale, and that is why this was asked about at all

The "Sub-issues" table still lists closed cards as `queued` / `blocked by …`, and "Timing" says *143 changesets in the root* where the tree now has **559**. ⇒ Anyone reading only the body concludes the epic has not started — which is precisely what prompted the maintainer's 「我记得早就升级了」. ⛔ Triage does not edit another epic's body; named here so the holder can.

## 四维分析(维护者裁决用)

- **实际业务需求** —— 拉动**已实测且是活的**:三张卡真实停着,其中 #9709 是缓存投毒面(`release.yml` 失败也保存 + 路径过滤 ⇒ 「ci 会先抓到」被证伪),修复一步。⛔ 不是投机能力面 —— 被挡的工作已经写好判据了。选项 B 的代价按**月**计。
- **项目长远合理性** —— C 让状态说真话:实现完结的 epic 就该关闭,剩下的验证是它自己的卡。A 留下一个「围栏已释放但机器不知道」的口头状态,正是本仓最贵的那类半状态 —— **散文与机械读数分叉**。契约优先的读法:解锁谓词是「目标关闭」,那就让目标关闭,⛔ 不要在它旁边加一套只有人能读的例外。
- **防 AI 写代码犯错** —— C **结构性地**更难错:它用既有解锁扫描,零新机制、零新标签。A 要求每个后来的 agent 都记得「这个围栏虽然开着但其实已释放」——**靠记忆的例外正是 AI 批量犯错的温床**。⭐ 并且本卡本身就是一个活例:一个只活在评论里的建议,四个小时内没有任何机械视图看见它。
- **创业阶段不扩散需求** —— C 是**收缩**不是扩张:关掉一个协调节点、少一层间接。⛔ 不新建机制、不加标签、不改任何 changeset 语义。且 2026-08-27「不考虑渐进」裁定同向 —— A 本质是一个过渡态,C 是一次付清。

**四棱同向指向 C。** ⛔ 但本卡**不走代裁**:关闭他人 epic 父单并解散已声明的文件领地是持有方/维护者的动作,且本席不达代裁档位 ⇒ 原样留在决策箱。
